_note: Q (Hate Spike): base MissileDamage (HateSpikeBaseDamage+0.25AP) curated; TotalBonusDamage (the 'every 3rd cast' stacking bonus, QStackCount=3) is skipped -- the schema's Count/bonusEffect triggers don't model an every-Nth-cast counter, and always-adding it would overcount 2 of every 3 casts (tagged Stacking on the slot instead of fabricating a number). W (Allure): the ONLY resolvable calc (MonsterDamageTotalTOOLTIP) is explicitly monster-only (jungle-camp damage); matches Allure's real kit (pure charm/stun utility vs champions, no direct champion damage) -- correctly left with no hits. W does carry a real MR-shred debuff (MRShred DataValue 32.5%->47.5%) but since W would then have zero direct/bonus hits the whole slot is dropped by SkillDamageDb's loader (hits.Length==0 && bonus.Length==0 -> slot discarded), so this is documented here instead of as a structurally-inert tag. E (Whiplash) has two tiers -- base vs 'Empowered' (target below a health threshold, exact % not present in E's own DataValues); curated the Empowered/execute-condition tier (PercentHealthEmpoweredTOOLTIP, %maxHP) as the primary hit (Darius-R 'assume the intended/finishing use' precedent) -- the lower base tier is skipped to avoid double-counting. R (Last Caress): base Damage vs CritDamage (=Damage*2.4, the empowered value against low-health targets, Evelynn's real 'crit' mechanic); curated CritDamage as primary (same execute-condition precedent as E), tagged BurstCeiling. P (Demon Shade) is a stealth/self-heal passive only, no damage.
_noteQ_appliesTo: APPLIES-TO CURATED (loop 476). _noteE_sweep: SWEEP §41 (2026-07-20): found by tools/sweep_unreferenced_damage.py (Zac-W risk class: a damage term whose DataValue no GameCalculation references is invisible to calc-name-driven curation). Wiki-verified against the live tooltip; the BIN array matches the tooltip digit-for-digit once the rank-0 placeholder at index 0 is dropped, which is the corroboration that it is live, not vestigial. Curated as a BIN-sourced dynamic reference -- no patch-dependent number is hardcoded. Evelynn E (Whiplash) is flat + %maxHP. The flat term (EmpoweredDamage, 40/80/120/160/200/240/280 per rank) was originally dropped, curating only PercentHealthEmpoweredTOOLTIP -- FIXED in CLAUDE_CODE_TODO #41's undercount sweep (flatDataValue 'EmpoweredDamage' added, count 1, alongside the existing %maxHP hit); this note text is retained for history but the flat term IS now present in the E hits array below (verified loop 219, both entries correct against the BIN). EmpoweredDamage is paired with the EMPOWERED %maxHP already curated -- the empowered cast REPLACES the base cast (Demon Shade resets the CD and empowers the next one), so base and empowered are alternatives, never additive; curating the empowered pair matches this project's model-the-fully-realized-version convention.
